args.message:
I added up order amounts and return amounts separately, so neither total is double-counted, and grouped them by the region of each customer. Orders and returns whose customer is unknown or has no region are in the null row.

| Region | Total ordered | Total returned |
|---|---|---|
| North | 109,334.76 | 2,740.62 |
| South | 104,269.90 | 3,698.96 |
| East | 68,738.70 | 2,418.45 |
| West | 49,151.79 | 1,054.47 |
| null (unknown customer or no region) | 1,193.30 | 25.00 |

The rounded figures here are for reading; the submitted table has the exact values.
